//: Typechecks the test files, which the build config excludes. The build config cannot do it: these tests import apps/registry's harness and apps/mcp's client by relative path (the pattern apps/mcp/src/e2e.test.ts established for driving the real app in-process), and `rootDir: src` rejects any file outside this package. So this config drops rootDir/outDir and emits nothing. Without it the doc guards in this package — which are the repo's defence against a fabricated figure — were never typechecked at all.
